title: Finite scalar kernel coordinates for finite étale sections and their thickenings
statement: Let R be Noetherian, S a commutative ring, f:R→S, V an open of Spec R, and P→V finite étale. Write V_n=V×Spec(R/ker(f)^(n+1)) and P_n=P×Spec(R/ker(f)^(n+1)). There exist finite coordinate counts r,t, injective maps e:Γ(P,O)→Γ(V,O)^r and en:Γ(P_n,O)→Γ(V_n,O)^r, and a t by r matrix c over Γ(V,O), such that every vector annihilated by c is e(a) for some a, every en(a) is annihilated by the restricted matrix, and all coordinate maps commute with projections and consecutive-thickening transitions. No scalar comparison hypothesis is assumed. The scalar and scheme conventions are def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring and def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions; finite étale objects are def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, construction of the universally exact sequence in (2)→(3), with O_V ample; finite affine base change

proof.text: V is Noetherian quasi-affine. Apply finite flat pushforward to O_P to obtain the finite locally free module E=p_*O_P.

Because O_V is ample and V is quasi-compact, the dual of E has finitely many global generators. Their surjection O^r→E dual splits locally. Dualize to a universally injective E→O^r with locally free cokernel C. Repeat for C to produce a universally exact sequence 0→E→O^r→O^t, as in the cited construction of Tag 0EKP.

Write the second map as a matrix c of global functions. Global sections preserve kernels, yielding e, its injectivity, and the lifting assertion for vectors in the matrix kernel. Pull back the universally exact sequence to V_n. Affine base change for the finite morphism identifies the pulled back E with (p_n)_*O_(P_n), yielding en, its injectivity and the matrix relations. Naturality gives the two coordinate compatibility formulas. No inverse-limit or scalar-comparison argument is part of this lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtale_adic_sections_kernel
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (f : R →+* S) (V : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) (P : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale) :
    ∃ (r t : ℕ)
      (e : Γ(P.obj.left, ⊤) → Fin r → Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤))
      (en : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.cover f V P n, ⊤) →
        Fin r → Γ(Limits.pullback V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap f n), ⊤))
      (c : Fin t → Fin r → Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤)),
      Function.Injective e ∧
      (∀ n, Function.Injective (en n)) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin r → Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤),
        (∀ j : Fin t, ∑ i : Fin r, c j i * x i = 0) → ∃ a, e a = x) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.cover f V P n, ⊤)) (j : Fin t),
        ∑ i : Fin r, (pullback.fst V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap f n)).appTop
          (c j i) * en n a i = 0) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Γ(P.obj.left, ⊤)) (i : Fin r),
        en n ((FiniteEtale.Adic.coverMap f V P n).appTop a) i =
          (pullback.fst V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap f n)).appTop (e a i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.cover f V P (n + 1), ⊤)) (i : Fin r),
        en n ((FiniteEtale.Adic.coverTransition f V P n).appTop a) i =
          (pullback.lift (pullback.fst V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap f n))
            (pullback.snd V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap f n) ≫
              FiniteEtale.Adic.baseTransition f n)
            (by rw [Category.assoc, FiniteEtale.Adic.baseTransition_comp_baseMap]
                exact pullback.condition)).appTop (en (n + 1) a i))
